text.p: Atlantic International Entertainment Ltd said Tuesday it has entered into an agreement to acquire The EmiNet Domain, an Internet service provider and developer of Internet-related software products, for $2.02 million in cash and stock.

Atlantic said that shareholders of EmiNet have the ability to earn additional shares of Atlantic stock if certain 1997 and 1998 earnings targets are met. The company would not disclose those earnings target.
EmiNet is based in Boynton Beach, Fla.

"We are confident that the addition of this company will help play an important role in providing the additional resources required to meet the product demands of 1997 and beyond," Atlantic President and Chief Executive Richard Iamunno said in a statement.
